content: My brother found some slides that had some never-before-seen photos of my parents. Here’s a great one of my dad. He was my best friend and such a gray dad. I am so lucky to have had him. I model a lot of my own parenting after him. He died from pancreatic cancer in 2007 and I’ve never stopped missing him. Happy Father’s Day (and first day of summer and Go Skateboarding Day) to all of the dads out there.
